decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: for the Sabbath: sung on the seventh day
decisions.reason: This is the only psalm whose Hebrew title names a day. The Mishnah (Tamid 7:4) lists a psalm the Levites sang in the temple for each day of the week, with this one for the Sabbath. The psalm praises God's works (verses 5-6), fitting the day that remembers creation (Exodus 20:11).

decisions.choice: a psalm, a song
decisions.reason: Both words name a song: mizmor is a song with music (3:1), shir is the ordinary word for a song (46:1).

decisions.choice: "Zaburi" kept at Readable here, where the English Readable keeps "A psalm"
decisions.reason: The title has both a psalm and a song, and the English Readable keeps both; Swahili does the same rather than say "song" twice.

decisions.choice: "안식일"
decisions.reason: The word the Korean New Testament uses for the seventh day (style guide section 6); the song was sung on it (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "a psalm, a song for the Sabbath day" as "መዝሙር። ለሰንበት ቀን ቅኔ።" (Literal), "… መዝሙር" (Balanced), "በሰንበት የሚዘመር መዝሙር" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the terms list for mizmor and shir, and as Psalm 30:1 ("የቤቱ መመረቂያ ቅኔ / መዝሙር").

decisions.choice: "भजन" (mizmor) and "गीत" (shir) at every level; "सब्त"
decisions.reason: The title names both a psalm and a song (meaning m3). The poetry note makes mizmor "भजन" and shir "गीत"; because both words stand side by side here, Readable keeps "भजन" too rather than saying "गीत" twice, as the English keeps "A psalm" at Readable. The Sabbath is "सब्त", as in the Pentateuch and the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "Псалом. Песнь" (L, B); "Песнь. Песня" (R)
decisions.reason: As the poetry note's table settles for mizmor and shir at each level; the Sabbath is "суббота", as the Pentateuch note settles.

decisions.choice: mizmor "賛歌" (L, B), "歌" (R); shir "歌"; leyom hashabbat "安息日のための"
decisions.reason: The Psalter's title words (PSA-1 conventions); the English separates mizmor and shir by a full stop, so the Japanese does too. 安息日 is the NT word for the Sabbath (m2).

ru.L: Хорошо — благодарить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} \q и воспевать {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя, Всевышний,

ja.L: 良いことだ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝し、 \q いと高き方よ、あなたの名にほめ歌を歌うことは、
ja.B: 良いことだ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝し、 \q いと高き方よ、楽器を奏でて、あなたの名をほめ歌うことは、
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝するのは、良いことだ。 \q すべてのものの上におられる神よ、あなたをほめ歌うのは、良いことだ。

decisions.choice: sing praises: sing with music
decisions.reason: The verb (zamar) means to sing and play in praise (7:18), the root of mizmor, "psalm" (verse 1).

decisions.choice: your name, Most High: from speaking about God to speaking to him
decisions.reason: The first line speaks of the LORD; the second turns to address him. The sentence runs on to verse 4, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title ('Elyon) means: God above everything.

decisions.choice: Each of verses 2-4 is closed as a sentence of its own, with "좋다" (good) said or understood in each; the verse is in 합쇼체 from its first line
alternatives: one sentence running from verse 2 to verse 4
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew the infinitives of verses 3-4 depend on "good" in verse 2. Korean puts "좋다" at the end of the clause it governs, which would pull verses 3-4 into verse 2, so each verse repeats or supplies it. The second line addresses God (meaning decision m2), so the whole sentence takes the polite style of prayer, as in 89:2.

decisions.choice: salmodiar
decisions.reason: The verb is the root of mizmor, "psalm" (m1), and Portuguese has the matching verb, "salmodiar", to sing psalms with music, so Literal keeps the link with the title; Balanced says "cantar e tocar", as the English Balanced says "sing and play".

decisions.choice: honorific "का धन्यवाद" of the LORD, then "तेरे" to God
decisions.reason: The first line speaks about the LORD and the second turns to him (meaning m2). Hindi needs no pronoun for God in the first line; in the second it says "तेरे", the devotional address used in prayer, as the rest of the psalm does. "Give thanks" is "धन्यवाद करना" and "sing praises" (zamar, meaning m1) "भजन गाना" at Literal, as the poetry note has it.

decisions.choice: tov "良いことだ" put first, with the infinitives of 92:2-4 following it as one list (…ことは、)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens with 'good' and hangs three verses of infinitives on it. Putting the predicate first lets each verse keep its own content, as the English; R makes each verse its own sentence with 良いことだ, as the English R. The address changes from 'the LORD' to 'your name, Most High' (m2), kept as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: zammer "ほめ歌を歌う" (L), "楽器を奏でて…ほめ歌う" (B), "ほめ歌う" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is singing with music (m1); B says so, as the English B.

records.literal_gloss: to declare in the morning your loyal love, and your faithfulness in the nights,

en.L: to declare in the morning {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness in the nights,
en.B: to tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love at sunrise \q and of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness through the nights,

fr.R: C’est bien de parler de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle chaque matin, \q et de dire chaque soir combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle.

sw.L: kutangaza asubuhi upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, \q na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} nyakati za usiku,
sw.B: kusimulia upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma jua linapochomoza \q na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiku kucha,
sw.R: Ni vizuri kueleza juu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma kila asubuhi, \q na juu ya jinsi ulivyo mwaminifu kila usiku.

es.L: anunciar por la mañana {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad en las noches,
es.B: contar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel al salir el sol \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad durante las noches,
es.R: Es bueno hablar de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel cada mañana, \q y de lo fiel que eres cada noche.

vi.L: rao truyền tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào buổi sáng, \q và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong những đêm khuya,
vi.B: thuật lại tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lúc bình minh \q và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} suốt những đêm thâu,
vi.R: Mỗi buổi sáng, kể về tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là điều tốt, \q và mỗi tối, kể về sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng vậy.

ko.L: 아침에 주님의 한결같은 사랑을, \q 밤마다 주님의 신실하심을 알리는 것이 [좋습니다].
ko.B: 해 뜰 때에 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 전하고 \q 밤마다 주님의 신실하심을 알리는 것이 좋습니다.
ko.R: 아침마다 주님의 변함없는 사랑을 이야기하는 것이 좋습니다. \q 밤마다 주님께서 얼마나 신실하신지 이야기하는 것이 좋습니다.

pt.L: anunciar de manhã o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade nas noites,
pt.B: falar do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal ao nascer do sol \q e da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade noite após noite,
pt.R: É bom falar do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel todas as manhãs \q e de como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és fiel todas as noites.

am.L: በማለዳ ጽኑ ፍቅርህን፣ \q በሌሊቶችም ታማኝነትህን መናገር፣
am.B: ፀሐይ ስትወጣ ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ፣ \q በሌሊቶችም ሁሉ ስለ ታማኝነትህ መናገር፣
am.R: በየማለዳው ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ መናገር መልካም ነው፤ \q በየሌሊቱም ምን ያህል ታማኝ እንደ ሆንህ መናገር መልካም ነው።

hi.L: भोर को तेरे अटल प्रेम का, \q और रात-रात तेरी सच्चाई का वर्णन करना,

hi.R: हर सुबह तेरे अटल प्रेम के बारे में बताना अच्छा है, \q और हर रात यह बताना कि तू कितना विश्वासयोग्य है।

ru.L: возвещать утром {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} неизменную любовь \q и {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} верность по ночам,

ru.R: Хорошо каждое утро рассказывать о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви \q и каждую ночь — о том, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} верен.

ja.L: 朝に、あなたの誠実を、 \q 夜ごとに、あなたの真実を告げることは、
ja.B: 朝日の昇るころに、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみを、 \q 夜ごとに、あなたの真実を語ることは、
ja.R: 毎朝、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみについて語り、 \q 毎晩、あなたがどんなに真実な方かを語るのは、良いことだ。

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: morning and nights: all the time
decisions.reason: Naming the two ends of the day means praise at every hour (55:18).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: It is good
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and repeats the opening words of verse 2.

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" at every level; "सच्चाई" (L), "विश्वासयोग्यता" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's hesed (meaning m1) is "अटल प्रेम" at every level, also where the English Readable says "faithful love"; God's faithfulness is "सच्चाई" at Literal and "विश्वासयोग्यता" at Balanced and Readable, as the poetry note has it.

decisions.choice: chasdekha "あなたの誠実" (L), "あなたの変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R); 'emunatekha "あなたの真実" (L, B), "真実な方" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's forms for chesed (m1) and 'emunah; morning and nights together mean all the time (m2).

records.literal_gloss: on [the] ten and on [the] harp, on [the] melody with [the] lyre.

en.L: on [the instrument of] ten [strings] and on [the] harp, \q with [the] melody on [the] lyre.
en.B: with the ten-stringed instrument and the harp, \q to the sounding music of the lyre.
en.R: It is good to do this with music on harps and lyres, \q and on instruments with ten strings.

fr.L: sur [l’instrument à] dix [cordes] et sur [la] harpe, \q avec [la] mélodie sur [la] lyre.
fr.B: avec l’instrument à dix cordes et la harpe, \q au son de la musique de la lyre.
fr.R: C’est bien de le faire en musique, avec des harpes et des lyres, \q et avec des instruments à dix cordes.

sw.L: kwa [chombo cha nyuzi] kumi na kwa zeze, \q kwa sauti tamu ya kinubi.
sw.B: kwa chombo cha nyuzi kumi na zeze, \q kwa muziki unaovuma wa kinubi.
sw.R: Ni vizuri kufanya hivyo kwa muziki wa zeze na vinubi, \q na kwa vyombo vyenye nyuzi kumi.

es.L: con [el instrumento de] diez [cuerdas] y con [el] arpa, \q con [la] melodía en [la] lira.
es.B: con el instrumento de diez cuerdas y el arpa, \q al son resonante de la lira.
es.R: Es bueno hacerlo con música de arpas y liras, \q y con instrumentos de diez cuerdas.

vi.L: trên [đàn] mười [dây] và trên đàn hạc, \q với giai điệu trên đàn lia.
vi.B: cùng với đàn mười dây và đàn hạc, \q theo tiếng nhạc vang lên của đàn lia.
vi.R: Làm điều ấy với tiếng đàn hạc và đàn lia, \q cùng với những cây đàn mười dây, thật là tốt.

ko.L: 열 [줄 악기]와 비파로, \q 수금의 울리는 가락으로 [그리하는 것이 좋습니다].
ko.B: 열 줄 악기와 비파를 타고 \q 수금의 울리는 가락에 맞추어 그리하는 것이 좋습니다.
ko.R: 비파와 수금으로 \q 열 줄 악기로 음악을 연주하며 그렇게 하는 것이 좋습니다.

pt.L: sobre [o instrumento de] dez [cordas] e sobre [a] harpa, \q com [a] melodia na lira.
pt.B: com o instrumento de dez cordas e a harpa, \q ao som vibrante da lira.
pt.R: É bom fazer isso com música de harpas e liras \q e de instrumentos de dez cordas.

am.B: ባለ አሥር አውታር መሣሪያና በበገና፣ \q በሚያስተጋባውም የመሰንቆ ዜማ።
am.R: ይህንም በበገናና በመሰንቆ ሙዚቃ፣ \q ባለ አሥር አውታር መሣሪያም ማድረግ መልካም ነው።

hi.L: दस [तार वाले बाजे] पर और सारंगी पर, \q वीणा पर गूँजते स्वर के साथ।
hi.B: दस तार वाले बाजे और सारंगी के साथ, \q वीणा के गूँजते संगीत के साथ।
hi.R: सारंगी और वीणा के संगीत के साथ यह करना अच्छा है, \q और दस तार वाले बाजों के साथ भी।

ru.L: на [инструменте в] десять [струн] и на арфе, \q с напевом на лире.
ru.B: с десятиструнным инструментом и с арфой, \q под звучную музыку лиры.
ru.R: Хорошо делать это под музыку арф и лир \q и инструментов с десятью струнами.

ja.L: 十[弦の琴]と琴に合わせ、 \q 竪琴の調べに合わせて。
ja.B: 十弦の琴と琴に合わせ、 \q 竪琴の響く調べに合わせて。
ja.R: 琴やたて琴で音楽を奏で、 \q 十本の弦のある楽器も使って、そうするのは良いことだ。

decisions.choice: ten-stringed instrument, harp, lyre
decisions.reason: The kinnor was a hand-held lyre and the nevel a larger stringed instrument (33:2); the "ten" ('asor) is an instrument with ten strings, or a ten-stringed harp, as in 33:2 and 144:9.

decisions.choice: melody: a resounding sound
decisions.reason: The word (higgayon) is the one left as "Higgaion" in 9:17; here it is the sound of the lyre.

decisions.choice: It is good to do this
decisions.reason: Readable makes the verse its own sentence.

decisions.choice: "zeze" for the harp (nevel), "kinubi" for the lyre (kinnor), "chombo cha nyuzi kumi" for the ten-stringed instrument
alternatives: "kinubi" for the harp and "zeze" for the lyre
decisions.reason: Swahili has its own names for stringed instruments; "kinubi" for the lyre and "zeze" for the harp is the pairing used through the Psalms (150:3), Samuel and Chronicles, and keeps the two Hebrew instruments apart. The ten-stringed instrument is described rather than given a third name.

decisions.choice: "đàn mười dây", "đàn hạc", "đàn lia"
decisions.reason: The three are stringed instruments (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese names them by plain descriptive words; the older "đàn cầm" and "đàn sắt" name Chinese instruments.

decisions.choice: the harp (nevel) as "በገና" and the lyre (kinnor) as "መሰንቆ", as 2 Samuel 6:5; "አሥር [አውታር መሣሪያ]" for the ten-stringed instrument
decisions.reason: The instruments keep the names used for them on main; the meaning decision is uncertain which instruments are meant.

decisions.choice: "सारंगी" (nevel, harp); "वीणा" (kinnor, lyre); "दस तार वाला बाजा"
decisions.reason: The two stringed instruments keep the names 1 Chronicles 15-16 and 25 and Psalm 81:3 use in this translation (meaning m1): "सारंगी" for the harp and "वीणा" for the lyre. The "ten" is an instrument with ten strings; Literal brackets the words Hindi supplies.

decisions.choice: "арфа" (nevel); "лира" (kinnor)
decisions.reason: The instruments keep the names the other psalms use (33:2, 57:9, 81:3).

decisions.choice: 'asor "十[弦の琴]" (L), "十弦の琴" (B), "十本の弦のある楽器" (R); nevel "琴"; kinnor "竪琴" (L, B), "たて琴" (R); higgayon "調べ" (L), "響く調べ" (B)
decisions.reason: The instruments as 33:2 and 81:3 (m1, uncertain); higgayon here is a resounding melody (m2), not the title word Higgaion of 9:17.

source.text: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For you have made me glad, YHWH, by your work; at [the] works of your hands I shout for joy.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me glad, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} work; \q at the works of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands I shout for joy.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} deeds, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have filled me with joy; \q I sing out over all that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have made.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done make me happy. \q I sing for joy about everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as réjoui, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} œuvre ; \q devant les œuvres de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains, je crie de joie.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, m’ont rempli de joie ; \q je chante devant tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains ont fait.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait me rend heureux. \q Je chante de joie pour tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait.

sw.L: Kwa maana umenifurahisha, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kazi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q kwa kazi za mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninapiga kelele za furaha.
sw.B: Kwa maana matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yamenijaza furaha; \q ninaimba kwa sauti juu ya yote ambayo mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imefanya.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mambo uliyoyafanya yananifurahisha. \q Ninaimba kwa furaha juu ya kila kitu ulichofanya.

es.L: Porque me has alegrado, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} obra; \q ante las obras de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos grito de júbilo.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, me han llenado de alegría; \q canto con júbilo por todo lo que han hecho {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, las cosas que has hecho me hacen feliz. \q Canto de alegría por todo lo que has hecho.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi vui mừng, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bởi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q trước các công việc của tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi reo hò vui mừng.
vi.B: Vì lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm đã khiến tôi tràn đầy vui mừng; \q tôi reo hát vì mọi điều tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm khiến tôi vui sướng. \q Tôi hát vui mừng về mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 하신 일로 주님께서 저를 기쁘게 하셨으니, \q 주님의 손이 하신 일들로 제가 기뻐 외칩니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 하신 일들이 저를 기쁨으로 채웠으니, \q 주님의 손으로 지으신 모든 것을 보고 제가 기뻐 노래합니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 하신 일들 때문에 저는 행복합니다. \q 주님께서 하신 모든 일을 생각하며 기뻐 노래합니다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me alegraste, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} obra; \q com as obras das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} mãos eu grito de alegria.
pt.B: Pois os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} feitos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, me encheram de alegria; \q eu canto com entusiasmo por tudo o que as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} mãos fizeram.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, as coisas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste me deixam feliz. \q Eu canto de alegria por tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በሥራህ ደስ አሰኝተኸኛልና፤ \q በእጆችህ ሥራ እልል እላለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሥራዎችህ በደስታ ሞልተውኛልና፤ \q እጆችህ በሠሩት ሁሉ በዝማሬ እደሰታለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ያደረግሃቸው ነገሮች ደስ ያሰኙኛል። \q ስላደረግኸው ነገር ሁሉ በደስታ እዘምራለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तूने अपने काम से मुझे आनंदित किया है; \q तेरे हाथों के कामों के कारण मैं जयजयकार करता हूँ।
hi.B: क्योंकि हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरे कामों ने मुझे आनंद से भर दिया है; \q जो कुछ तेरे हाथों ने बनाया है, उस पर मैं जयजयकार करता हूँ।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो काम तूने किए हैं, वे मुझे ख़ुश करते हैं। \q तूने जो कुछ किया है, उसके कारण मैं आनंद से गाता हूँ।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} обрадовал меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} делом; \q при [виде] дел {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} рук я ликую.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} дела, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, наполнили меня радостью; \q я пою от радости обо всём, что сотворили {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} руки.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал, радует меня. \q Я пою от радости обо всём, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはあなたのみわざによって、わたしを喜ばせてくださった。 \q あなたの手のわざを、わたしは喜び歌う。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたのみわざは、わたしを喜びで満たした。 \q あなたの手が造られたすべてのものを見て、わたしは喜び歌う。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたがなさったことを思うと、わたしはうれしくなる。 \q あなたがしてくださったすべてのことを、わたしは喜んで歌う。

decisions.choice: your work, the works of your hands: what God has made and done
decisions.reason: The words take in creation and God's acts in history, including the judgment of the wicked in verses 8-12 (90:16; 143:5).

decisions.choice: all that your hands have made (B); everything you have done (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of hands; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: po'olekha "あなたのみわざ" (L, B), "あなたがなさったこと" (R); ma'asei yadekha "あなたの手のわざ" (L), "あなたの手が造られたすべてのもの" (B), "あなたがしてくださったすべてのこと" (R)
decisions.reason: God's work and the works of his hands are what he has made and done (m1).

source.text: מַה־גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: How great are your works, YHWH! Exceedingly deep are your thoughts.

en.L: How great are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Exceedingly deep are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} thoughts.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how great the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do! \q How very deep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} plans!
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do such great things! \q Your thoughts go deeper than we can understand.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres sont grandes, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Très profondes sont {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pensées.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres sont grandes ! \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} desseins sont profonds !
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais de si grandes choses ! \q Tes pensées sont trop profondes pour que nous les comprenions.

sw.L: Jinsi zilivyo kuu kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Mawazo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ni ya kina kirefu mno.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mambo unayoyafanya ni makuu mno! \q Mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ina kina kirefu ajabu!
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unafanya mambo makuu mno! \q Mawazo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yana kina kuliko tunavyoweza kuelewa.

es.L: ¡Qué grandes son {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! \q Muy profundos son {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pensamientos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡qué grandes las cosas que haces! \q ¡Qué profundos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} designios!
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces cosas tan grandes! \q Tus pensamientos son más profundos de lo que podemos entender.

vi.L: Các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao biết bao, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Những ý tưởng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu xa vô cùng.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm thật lớn lao! \q Các ý định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu xa biết bao!
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm những việc thật vĩ đại! \q Ý nghĩ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu xa hơn điều chúng tôi có thể hiểu.

ko.L: 주님께서 하신 일들이 얼마나 위대한지요, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여! \q 주님의 생각은 참으로 깊습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 하시는 일이 어찌 그리 위대합니까! \q 주님의 계획은 어찌 그리 깊습니까!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 정말 큰일들을 하십니다! \q 주님의 생각은 저희가 깨달을 수 없을 만큼 깊습니다.

pt.L: Quão grandes são as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} obras, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! \q Profundíssimos são os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pensamentos.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, como são grandes as coisas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes! \q Como são profundos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} planos!
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes coisas tão grandes! \q Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pensamentos são profundos demais para nós entendermos.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሥራዎችህ እንዴት ታላላቅ ናቸው! \q አሳብህ እጅግ ጥልቅ ነው።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የምትሠራው እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! \q ዕቅዶችህ እንዴት እጅግ ጥልቅ ናቸው!
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እንዴት ያሉ ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ታደርጋለህ! \q አሳብህ ልንረዳው ከምንችለው በላይ ጥልቅ ነው።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरे काम कितने महान हैं! \q तेरे विचार अति गहरे हैं।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू कितने महान काम करता है! \q तेरी योजनाएँ कितनी गहरी हैं!
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू कितने बड़े-बड़े काम करता है! \q तेरे विचार हमारी समझ से कहीं गहरे हैं।

ru.L: Как велики {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} дела, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! \q Весьма глубоки {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} мысли.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, как велико то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} делаешь! \q Как глубоки {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} замыслы!
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} делаешь такие великие дела! \q Твои мысли глубже, чем мы можем понять.

ja.L: なんと大きいことか、あなたのみわざは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ！ \q はなはだ深い、あなたの思いは。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたのなさることは、なんと偉大なことか！ \q あなたのご計画は、なんと深いことか！
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは本当に偉大なことをなさる！ \q あなたの考えは、わたしたちにはわからないほど深い。

decisions.choice: deep thoughts: plans beyond human understanding
decisions.reason: God's thoughts are his purposes (33:11; 40:6), too deep for people to see to the bottom. Verse 7 says who does not understand them.

decisions.choice: go deeper than we can understand
decisions.reason: Readable says what "deep" means (m1).

decisions.choice: machshevotekha "あなたの思い" (L), "あなたのご計画" (B), "あなたの考え" (R)
decisions.reason: God's deep thoughts are plans beyond human understanding (m1), which R says plainly.

source.text: אִֽישׁ־בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: A stupid man not knows, and a fool not understands this:

en.L: {{gender:A senseless person|A senseless man}} does not know, \q and a fool does not understand this:
en.B: Senseless people do not know it; \q fools cannot grasp this:
en.R: Foolish people do not know this. \q People without sense cannot understand it.

fr.L: {{gender:La personne stupide|L’homme stupide}} ne sait pas, \q et l’insensé ne comprend pas ceci :
fr.B: Les gens sans intelligence ne le savent pas ; \q les insensés ne peuvent comprendre ceci :
fr.R: Les gens stupides ne savent pas cela. \q Ceux qui n’ont pas de bon sens ne peuvent pas le comprendre.

sw.L: Mtu mjinga hajui, \q wala mpumbavu haelewi jambo hili:
sw.B: Watu wasio na akili hawalijui; \q wapumbavu hawawezi kulielewa hili:
sw.R: Watu wapumbavu hawajui jambo hili. \q Watu wasio na akili hawawezi kulielewa.

es.L: {{gender:La persona insensata|El hombre insensato}} no sabe, \q y el necio no entiende esto:
es.B: Los insensatos no lo saben; \q los necios no pueden comprender esto:
es.R: La gente tonta no sabe esto. \q Los que no tienen juicio no lo pueden entender.

vi.L: Người ngu muội không biết, \q và kẻ dại dột không hiểu điều này:
vi.B: Những người ngu muội không biết điều đó; \q những kẻ dại dột không thể hiểu điều này:
vi.R: Những người dại dột không biết điều này. \q Những người thiếu hiểu biết không thể hiểu được.

ko.L: 우둔한 사람은 알지 못하고, \q 미련한 자는 이것을 깨닫지 못합니다.
ko.B: 어리석은 사람들은 그것을 알지 못하고, \q 미련한 자들은 이것을 깨닫지 못합니다.
ko.R: 어리석은 사람들은 이것을 모릅니다. \q 생각이 없는 사람들은 이것을 깨닫지 못합니다.

pt.L: {{gender:Uma pessoa insensata|Um homem insensato}} não sabe, \q e o tolo não entende isto:
pt.B: As pessoas sem juízo não sabem disso; \q os tolos não conseguem entender isto:
pt.R: As pessoas tolas não sabem disso. \q As pessoas sem juízo não conseguem entender.

am.L: ደንቆሮ ሰው አያውቅም፤ \q ሞኝም ይህን አያስተውልም፦
am.B: ማስተዋል የጎደላቸው ሰዎች አያውቁትም፤ \q ሞኞችም ይህን ሊረዱ አይችሉም፦
am.R: ሞኝ ሰዎች ይህን አያውቁም። \q ማስተዋል የሌላቸው ሰዎች ሊረዱት አይችሉም።

hi.L: {{gender:पशु-बुद्धि व्यक्ति|पशु-बुद्धि मनुष्य}} नहीं जानता, \q और मूर्ख इसे नहीं समझता:
hi.B: नासमझ लोग यह नहीं जानते; \q मूर्ख इस बात को नहीं समझ पाते:
hi.R: मूर्ख लोग यह नहीं जानते। \q नासमझ लोग इसे नहीं समझ सकते।

ru.L: Неразумный человек не знает, \q и глупец не понимает этого:
ru.B: Бестолковые люди этого не знают; \q глупцы не могут понять вот чего:
ru.R: Глупые люди этого не знают. \q Люди без разума не могут этого понять.

ja.L: 愚鈍な人は知らず、 \q 愚か者はこれを悟らない。
ja.B: 分別のない者たちは、それを知らない。 \q 愚かな者たちは、このことを悟ることができない。
ja.R: 愚かな人たちは、このことを知らない。 \q わきまえのない人たちには、それがわからない。

decisions.choice: stupid: dull as an animal
decisions.reason: The word (ba'ar) describes a person no wiser than a beast (49:11; 73:22).

decisions.choice: this: what follows
decisions.reason: "This" points ahead to verse 8: the wicked flourish only to be destroyed.

decisions.choice: a senseless person (with "a senseless man" as the alternative at Literal); plurals at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The words describe anyone who will not understand, so Literal gives inclusive wording by default; Balanced and Readable use plurals.

decisions.choice: the gender setting on the noun at Literal: "La personne stupide" / "L'homme stupide"
decisions.reason: As the English: the Hebrew ʾish means anyone here. The adjective agrees with its noun, so it goes inside the span.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "ደንቆሮ ሰው"; the generic suffix in verse 13 ("ያብባል") likewise
decisions.reason: "ሰው" and the generic masculine suffix already cover men and women, so the English spans in verses 7 and 13 have no second Amharic wording.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:पशु-बुद्धि व्यक्ति|पशु-बुद्धि मनुष्य}}"; "पशु-बुद्धि" for ba'ar
decisions.reason: As in the English, the words describe anyone who will not understand, so Literal gives "व्यक्ति" by default and "मनुष्य", the Hebrew's word for a man, as the alternative. "पशु-बुद्धि" (with a beast's mind) keeps the sense of the word (meaning m1). Balanced and Readable use plurals with no span.

decisions.choice: "неразумный человек" with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Russian "человек" is not marked for sex, so the English setting ("person" or "man") needs no counterpart, as the Pentateuch note settles.

decisions.choice: 'ish-ba'ar "愚鈍な人" (L), "分別のない者たち" (B), "愚かな人たち" (R); kesil "愚か者" (L), "愚かな者たち" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English gender span (person / man) is not needed: 人 and 者 are already inclusive. ba'ar is dull as an animal (m1).

source.text: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: When [the] wicked sprout like grass and all [the] doers of wickedness flourish, [it is] for them to be destroyed forever.

en.L: when [the] wicked sprout like grass, \q and all who do wickedness flourish, \q [it is] that they may be destroyed forever.
en.B: though the wicked shoot up like green plants \q and all who do wrong are in bloom, \q it is only so that they may be destroyed for all time.
en.R: Wicked people may spring up like grass. \q Everyone who does evil may seem to do well. \q But they will be destroyed forever.

fr.L: quand [les] méchants germent comme l’herbe, \q et que fleurissent tous ceux qui font le mal, \q [c’est] pour être détruits pour toujours.
fr.B: même si les méchants poussent comme de l’herbe verte \q et que tous ceux qui font le mal sont en fleurs, \q ce n’est que pour être détruits à jamais.
fr.R: Les méchants peuvent pousser comme de l’herbe. \q Ceux qui font le mal peuvent avoir l’air de bien réussir. \q Mais ils seront détruits pour toujours.

sw.L: waovu wanapochipuka kama majani, \q na watenda maovu wote wanapostawi, \q [ni] ili waangamizwe milele.
sw.B: ingawa waovu wanaota kama mimea mibichi \q na watenda maovu wote wanachanua, \q ni ili tu waangamizwe milele.
sw.R: Waovu wanaweza kuota kama majani. \q Kila mtenda maovu anaweza kuonekana anafanikiwa. \q Lakini wataangamizwa milele.

es.L: que cuando [los] malvados brotan como la hierba, \q y florecen todos los que hacen maldad, \q [es] para ser destruidos para siempre.
es.B: aunque los malvados broten como plantas verdes \q y todos los que hacen el mal estén en flor, \q es solo para que sean destruidos para siempre.
es.R: Los malvados pueden brotar como la hierba. \q Todos los que hacen el mal pueden parecer que les va bien. \q Pero serán destruidos para siempre.

vi.L: khi [những] kẻ ác mọc lên như cỏ, \q và mọi kẻ làm điều gian ác được hưng thịnh, \q [ấy là] để chúng bị hủy diệt đời đời.
vi.B: dù kẻ ác mọc lên như cây cỏ xanh tươi \q và mọi kẻ làm điều sai trái đều nở hoa, \q thì chỉ là để chúng bị hủy diệt mãi mãi.
vi.R: Kẻ ác có thể mọc lên như cỏ. \q Mọi kẻ làm điều ác có thể trông như đang thành công. \q Nhưng chúng sẽ bị hủy diệt mãi mãi.

ko.L: 악인들이 풀처럼 돋아나고 \q 악을 행하는 모든 자가 번성하는 것은 \q 그들이 영원히 멸망하게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 악인들이 풀처럼 돋아나고 \q 악을 행하는 자들이 모두 꽃처럼 피어나도, \q 그것은 결국 그들이 영원히 망하게 되려는 것뿐입니다.
ko.R: 악한 사람들이 풀처럼 쑥쑥 자랄 수도 있습니다. \q 나쁜 짓을 하는 사람들이 모두 잘되는 것처럼 보일 수도 있습니다. \q 그러나 그들은 영원히 망할 것입니다.

pt.L: quando [os] ímpios brotam como a erva, \q e florescem todos os que praticam a maldade, \q [é] para serem destruídos para sempre.
pt.B: embora os ímpios cresçam como plantas verdes \q e todos os que fazem o mal estejam em flor, \q é só para serem destruídos de uma vez por todas.
pt.R: As pessoas más podem crescer como o capim. \q Pode parecer que todos os que fazem o mal vão bem. \q Mas eles serão destruídos para sempre.

am.L: ክፉዎች እንደ ሣር ሲበቅሉ፣ \q ክፋትን የሚሠሩም ሁሉ ሲያብቡ፣ \q ለዘላለም ይጠፉ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: ክፉዎች እንደ ለምለም ተክል ቢበቅሉ፣ \q ክፉ አድራጊዎችም ሁሉ ቢያብቡ፣ \q ይህ የሚሆነው ለዘላለም እንዲጠፉ ብቻ ነው።
am.R: ክፉ ሰዎች እንደ ሣር ሊበቅሉ ይችላሉ። \q ክፉ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ የተሳካለት ሊመስል ይችላል። \q ነገር ግን ለዘላለም ይጠፋሉ።

hi.L: कि जब दुष्ट घास के समान उगते हैं, \q और सब कुकर्मी फलते-फूलते हैं, \q [तो यह इसलिए है] कि वे सदा के लिए नष्ट किए जाएँ।
hi.B: कि चाहे दुष्ट हरी घास की तरह उग आएँ \q और सब कुकर्मी फूलें-फलें, \q यह केवल इसलिए है कि वे सदा के लिए नष्ट हो जाएँ।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोग घास की तरह उग सकते हैं। \q बुरे काम करनेवाले सब लोग फलते-फूलते दिख सकते हैं। \q पर वे सदा के लिए नष्ट हो जाएँगे।

ru.L: когда нечестивые прорастают, как трава, \q и процветают все делающие зло, — \q [это] для того, чтобы им погибнуть навеки.
ru.B: хотя нечестивые и пускают ростки, как зелень, \q и все, кто делает зло, цветут, \q это лишь для того, чтобы им погибнуть навсегда.
ru.R: Злые люди могут вырасти, как трава. \q Все, кто творит зло, могут казаться благополучными. \q Но они будут уничтожены навсегда.

ja.L: 悪しき者たちが草のように芽生え、 \q 悪を行う者たちがみな花を咲かせても、 \q それは、彼らがとこしえに滅ぼされるためである。
ja.B: 悪しき者たちが青草のように伸び、 \q 悪を行う者たちがみな栄えても、 \q それはただ、彼らが永遠に滅ぼされるためにすぎない。
ja.R: 悪い人たちは、草のようにどんどん伸びるかもしれない。 \q 悪いことをする人たちはみな、うまくいっているように見えるかもしれない。 \q しかし、彼らは永遠に滅ぼされる。

decisions.choice: like grass: quick to grow and quick to wither
decisions.reason: As in 37:2 and 90:5-6, grass springs up fast and dries up in a day; the righteous are like trees (verses 13-15).

decisions.choice: to be destroyed: their end
decisions.reason: The form says what their flourishing leads to: it ends in destruction for good.

decisions.choice: "악인" (L, B), "악한 사람" (R) for the wicked
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the published Psalm 1. The same holds for "의인" (L, B) and "바르게 사는 사람" (R) for the righteous in verse 13 and through Psalms 84-104.

decisions.choice: "कि" at the start
decisions.reason: Verse 7 ends with a colon pointing to this verse (meaning m2 there); Hindi begins it with "कि", which introduces what the fool does not know. The wicked are "दुष्ट" and the doers of wickedness "कुकर्मी", as the poetry note fixes them.

decisions.choice: "нечестивые" (L, B), "злые люди" (R); "делающие зло" (L), "все, кто делает зло" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's words for the wicked; "the doers of wickedness" (po'ale 'aven) is kept apart from "беззаконие", which this translation keeps for 'avon (iniquity), and has one wording through Psalms 92, 94 and 101.

decisions.choice: "草のように"; po'alei 'awen "悪を行う者たち" (L, B), "悪いことをする人たち" (R); lehishshamedam "滅ぼされるため"
decisions.reason: Grass grows fast and withers fast (m1); their flourishing ends in destruction (m2). The Psalter's forms for the wicked and the doers of wickedness.

records.literal_gloss: But you [are] on high forever, YHWH.

en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q are enthroned on high for all time.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q will rule from heaven forever.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] en haut \q pour toujours, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sièges sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône là-haut pour toujours.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} régneras du haut du ciel pour toujours.

sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q utatawala kutoka mbinguni milele.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [estás] en lo alto \q para siempre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q reinas en lo alto por todos los tiempos.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q gobernarás desde el cielo para siempre.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trên cao \q đến đời đời, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q ngự trên ngôi cao đến muôn đời.
vi.R: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q sẽ từ trên trời cai trị mãi mãi.

ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 주님은 영원히 높은 곳에서 다스리십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 주님께서는 하늘에서 영원히 다스리실 것입니다.

pt.B: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q reinas nas alturas para sempre.
pt.R: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q vais reinar do céu para sempre.

am.L: አንተ ግን ከፍ ያልህ [ነህ] \q ለዘላለም፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ።
am.B: አንተ ግን፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ \q ለዘላለም በላይ በዙፋንህ ተቀምጠሃል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ግን \q ከሰማይ ለዘላለም ትገዛለህ።

hi.L: पर तू ऊँचे पर [है] \q सदा के लिए, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}।
hi.B: पर हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू \q सदा के लिए ऊँचे पर विराजमान है।
hi.R: पर हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू \q स्वर्ग से सदा राज्य करेगा।

ru.B: Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q восседаешь на престоле в вышине вовеки.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q будешь править с небес вечно.

ja.L: しかし、あなたは高い所に[おられる]、 \q とこしえに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。
ja.B: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは、 \q とこしえに高い所に座しておられる。
ja.R: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは、 \q いつまでも天から、すべてを治めておられる。

decisions.choice: the center of the psalm
decisions.reason: This short line stands at the center of the psalm, with seven lines before it and seven after: the LORD above all, against the wicked who perish.

decisions.choice: on high: in the height, the place of God's throne
decisions.reason: The word (marom) is the height of heaven, where God reigns (7:8; 93:4).

decisions.choice: enthroned on high (B); rule from heaven (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what being on high means (m2).

decisions.choice: marom "高い所に[おられる]" (L), "高い所に座しておられる" (B), "天から、すべてを治めておられる" (R)
decisions.reason: On high is the height, the place of God's throne (m2); B and R make the throne explicit, as the English. This short line is the center of the psalm (m1).

source.text: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ׀יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, your enemies, YHWH, for look, your enemies will perish; all [the] doers of wickedness will be scattered.

en.L: For look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q for look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies will perish; \q all who do wickedness will be scattered.
en.B: Look at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies are doomed; \q everyone who does evil will be driven apart.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies will surely die. \q Everyone who does evil will be scattered.

fr.L: Car voici, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car voici, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis périront ; \q tous ceux qui font le mal seront dispersés.
fr.B: Regarde {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Oui, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis vont à leur perte ; \q tous ceux qui font le mal seront chassés de tous côtés.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis vont mourir, c’est sûr. \q Tous ceux qui font le mal seront dispersés.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana tazama, adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} wataangamia; \q watenda maovu wote watatawanyika.
sw.B: Tazama adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Tazama, adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} wataangamia; \q kila atendaye maovu atafukuzwa huku na huku.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakika adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} watakufa. \q Kila atendaye maovu atatawanyika.

es.L: Porque he aquí {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque he aquí, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos perecerán; \q serán dispersados todos los que hacen maldad.
es.B: ¡Mira a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! \q Mira, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos están perdidos; \q todos los que hacen el mal serán dispersados.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos de seguro morirán. \q Todos los que hacen el mal serán dispersados.

vi.L: Vì kìa, các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì kìa, các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị diệt vong; \q mọi kẻ làm điều gian ác sẽ bị tản lạc.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy xem các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Kìa, các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị tiêu diệt; \q mọi kẻ làm ác sẽ bị đánh tan tác.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chắc chắn sẽ chết. \q Mọi kẻ làm điều ác sẽ bị đánh tan.

ko.L: 참으로 보십시오, 주님의 원수들을, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 참으로 보십시오, 주님의 원수들은 망할 것이요, \q 악을 행하는 자들은 모두 흩어질 것입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 원수들을 보십시오! \q 보십시오, 주님의 원수들은 망하고 말 것입니다. \q 악을 행하는 자들은 모두 흩어질 것입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 원수들은 반드시 죽을 것입니다. \q 나쁜 짓을 하는 사람들은 모두 흩어질 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque eis os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q porque eis que os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos perecerão; \q serão dispersos todos os que praticam a maldade.
pt.B: Olha os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! \q Olha: os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos estão condenados; \q todos os que fazem o mal serão espalhados.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos com certeza vão morrer. \q Todos os que fazem o mal serão espalhados.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እነሆ ጠላቶችህ፣ \q እነሆ ጠላቶችህ ይጠፋሉና፤ \q ክፋትን የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ይበተናሉ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጠላቶችህን ተመልከት! \q ተመልከት፣ ጠላቶችህ መጥፋታቸው አይቀርም፤ \q ክፉ የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ተበታትነው ይሄዳሉ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጠላቶችህ በእርግጥ ይሞታሉ። \q ክፉ የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ይበተናሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि देख, तेरे शत्रु, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, \q क्योंकि देख, तेरे शत्रु नष्ट हो जाएँगे; \q सब कुकर्मी तितर-बितर किए जाएँगे।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने शत्रुओं को देख! \q देख, तेरे शत्रुओं का नाश निश्चित है; \q बुराई करनेवाले सब तितर-बितर कर दिए जाएँगे।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरे शत्रु निश्चय ही मर मिटेंगे। \q बुराई करनेवाले सब लोग तितर-बितर हो जाएँगे।

ru.L: Ведь вот, {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} враги, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q ведь вот, {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} враги погибнут; \q рассеются все делающие зло.
ru.B: Взгляни на {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} врагов, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! \q Вот, {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} враги обречены; \q все, кто делает зло, будут разогнаны.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} враги непременно погибнут. \q Все, кто творит зло, будут рассеяны.

ja.L: まことに、ああ、あなたの敵は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、 \q まことに、ああ、あなたの敵は滅びる。 \q 悪を行う者たちはみな、散らされる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの敵をご覧ください！ \q ご覧ください、あなたの敵は滅びる。 \q 悪を行う者たちはみな、散り散りにされる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの敵は必ず滅びる。 \q 悪いことをする人たちはみな、散らされる。

decisions.choice: the repeated line: rising emphasis
decisions.reason: The line starts, breaks off, and starts again, adding a word each time, a pattern of Hebrew poetry (93:3; 94:3).

decisions.choice: scattered: broken up like a defeated army
decisions.reason: The verb (parad) is used of a group separated and scattered (Job 4:11).

decisions.choice: hinneh "ああ" (L), "ご覧ください" (B), dropped in R
decisions.reason: hinneh is never 見よ in the Psalter; in a prayer it is ご覧ください (B), ああ at L. The repeated line rises in emphasis (m1), so L and B keep the repetition.

source.text: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you have raised like a wild ox my horn; I have been anointed with fresh oil.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have raised my horn like [that of] a wild ox; \q I have been anointed with fresh oil.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me strong like a wild ox; \q fresh oil has been poured over me.
en.R: You have made me as strong as a wild ox. \q You have poured fresh oil on me to honor me.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as élevé ma corne comme [celle d’]un buffle ; \q j’ai été oint d’une huile fraîche.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rendu fort comme un buffle ; \q une huile fraîche a été versée sur moi.
fr.R: Tu m’as rendu aussi fort qu’un buffle. \q Tu as versé sur moi de l’huile fraîche pour m’honorer.

sw.L: Lakini umeiinua pembe yangu kama [ya] nyati; \q nimepakwa mafuta mapya.
sw.B: Lakini umenifanya kuwa na nguvu kama nyati; \q mafuta mapya yamemiminwa juu yangu.
sw.R: Umenifanya kuwa na nguvu kama nyati. \q Umenimiminia mafuta mapya kunipa heshima.

es.L: Pero has levantado mi cuerno como [el del] búfalo; \q he sido ungido con aceite fresco.
es.B: Pero me has hecho fuerte como un búfalo; \q se ha derramado sobre mí aceite fresco.
es.R: Me has hecho tan fuerte como un búfalo. \q Has derramado aceite fresco sobre mí para honrarme.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nâng sừng tôi lên như [sừng] bò rừng; \q tôi đã được xức bằng dầu tươi.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ như con bò rừng; \q dầu tươi đã được đổ trên tôi.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ như con bò rừng. \q Ngài đã đổ dầu tươi trên tôi để tôn trọng tôi.

ko.L: 주님께서 제 뿔을 들소의 [뿔]처럼 높이셨고, \q 저는 신선한 기름으로 부음을 받았습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 저를 들소처럼 강하게 하셨고, \q 신선한 기름이 제 위에 부어졌습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 저를 들소처럼 힘세게 하셨습니다. \q 주님께서 저를 높이시려고 신선한 기름을 제게 부어 주셨습니다.

pt.L: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ergueste o meu chifre como [o de] um boi selvagem; \q fui ungido com óleo fresco.
pt.B: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me tornaste forte como um boi selvagem; \q óleo fresco foi derramado sobre mim.
pt.R: Tu me deste a força de um boi selvagem. \q Tu derramaste óleo fresco sobre mim para me honrar.

am.L: ቀንዴን ግን እንደ ጎሽ ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ፤ \q በአዲስ ዘይትም ተቀባሁ።
am.B: እኔን ግን እንደ ጎሽ ብርቱ አደረግኸኝ፤ \q አዲስ ዘይትም በላዬ ፈሰሰ።
am.R: እንደ ጎሽ ብርቱ አደረግኸኝ። \q ልታከብረኝ አዲስ ዘይት በላዬ አፈሰስክ።

hi.L: पर तूने जंगली साँड़ के समान मेरा सींग ऊँचा किया है; \q मुझ पर ताज़ा तेल मला गया है।
hi.B: पर तूने मुझे जंगली साँड़ के समान बलवान बनाया है; \q मुझ पर ताज़ा तेल उँडेला गया है।
hi.R: तूने मुझे जंगली साँड़ जितना बलवान बना दिया है। \q तूने मेरा आदर करने के लिए मुझ पर ताज़ा तेल उँडेला है।

ru.L: Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вознёс мой рог, как [рог] дикого быка; \q я помазан свежим маслом.
ru.B: Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал меня сильным, как дикий бык; \q на меня излито свежее масло.
ru.R: Ты сделал меня сильным, как дикий бык. \q Ты вылил на меня свежее масло в знак почёта.

ja.L: しかし、あなたは、わたしの角を野牛[の角]のように高く上げられた。 \q わたしは新しい油を注がれた。
ja.B: しかし、あなたはわたしを、野牛のように強くしてくださった。 \q 新しい油が、わたしの上に注がれた。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしを野牛のように強くしてくださった。 \q わたしに誉れを与えるために、新しい油を注いでくださった。

decisions.choice: raised my horn: made me strong and victorious
decisions.reason: A horn is a picture of an animal's strength, and raising it means victory and honor (75:11; 89:18; 1 Samuel 2:1).

decisions.choice: I have been anointed: soaked with oil
alternatives: my old age (is) with fresh oil
decisions.reason: The verb (balal) means to moisten or mix with oil. Oil on the head was a sign of honor and joy (23:5). The ancient Greek translation reads the word as "my old age".

decisions.choice: You have poured; to honor me
decisions.reason: Readable names who acts and what the oil means (m2).

decisions.choice: "मेरा सींग ऊँचा किया है"
decisions.reason: A raised horn is a picture of strength and victory (meaning m1). Literal keeps the picture, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "дикий бык"
decisions.reason: The animal (re'em) is the wild ox; the Synodal "единорог" follows the Greek and is not used.

decisions.choice: qarni "わたしの角" (L), "強く" (B, R); re'em "野牛"; balloti "油を注がれた" (L, B), "油を注いでくださった" (R)
decisions.reason: The raised horn is strength and victory (m1), in the Psalter's form (qeren 角 L, 力 B, R); balloti is soaked with oil (m2, uncertain), R supplies the honor as the English R.

source.text: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And my eye has looked on my watchers; on [those who] rise against me, evildoers, my ears have heard.

en.L: And my eye has looked on those who watch for me; \q of those who rise against me, evildoers, my ears have heard.
en.B: My eyes have looked in triumph on those who lay in wait for me; \q my ears have heard what became of the evildoers who rose up against me.
en.R: I have seen my enemies defeated. \q I have heard about the end of the evil people who attacked me.

fr.L: Et mon œil a regardé ceux qui me guettent ; \q de ceux qui se lèvent contre moi, des malfaiteurs, mes oreilles ont entendu.
fr.B: Mes yeux ont vu, triomphants, ceux qui me guettaient ; \q mes oreilles ont appris ce qui est arrivé aux malfaiteurs qui se dressaient contre moi.
fr.R: J’ai vu mes ennemis vaincus. \q J’ai entendu parler de la fin des gens mauvais qui m’attaquaient.

sw.L: Na jicho langu limewatazama wanaonivizia; \q juu ya wale wanaoniinukia, watenda mabaya, masikio yangu yamesikia.
sw.B: Macho yangu yamewatazama kwa ushindi wale walioniotea; \q masikio yangu yamesikia yaliyowapata watenda maovu walioniinukia.
sw.R: Nimewaona adui zangu wakishindwa. \q Nimesikia habari za mwisho wa watu waovu walionishambulia.

es.L: Y mi ojo ha mirado a los que me acechan; \q de los que se levantan contra mí, malhechores, han oído mis oídos.
es.B: Mis ojos han visto con triunfo a los que me acechaban; \q mis oídos han oído lo que les pasó a los malhechores que se alzaron contra mí.
es.R: He visto a mis enemigos derrotados. \q He oído del fin de la gente malvada que me atacó.

vi.L: Và mắt tôi đã nhìn những kẻ rình rập tôi; \q về những kẻ nổi lên chống lại tôi, những kẻ làm ác, tai tôi đã nghe.
vi.B: Mắt tôi đã đắc thắng nhìn những kẻ rình rập tôi; \q tai tôi đã nghe kết cục của những kẻ làm ác đã nổi lên chống lại tôi.
vi.R: Tôi đã thấy kẻ thù mình bị đánh bại. \q Tôi đã nghe về kết cục của những kẻ ác đã tấn công tôi.

ko.L: 제 눈이 저를 엿보는 자들을 내려다보았고, \q 저를 치러 일어난 악한 자들에 대하여 제 귀가 들었습니다.
ko.B: 제 눈은 저를 노리던 자들이 무너지는 것을 보았고, \q 제 귀는 저를 치러 일어난 악한 자들이 어떻게 되었는지 들었습니다.
ko.R: 저는 제 원수들이 지는 것을 보았습니다. \q 저를 공격하던 악한 사람들이 어떻게 끝났는지 들었습니다.

pt.L: E o meu olho olhou para os que me espreitam; \q dos que se levantam contra mim, malfeitores, os meus ouvidos ouviram.
pt.B: Os meus olhos viram, em triunfo, os que ficavam de tocaia contra mim; \q os meus ouvidos ouviram o fim dos malfeitores que se levantaram contra mim.
pt.R: Eu vi os meus inimigos derrotados. \q Eu ouvi falar do fim das pessoas más que me atacaram.

am.L: ዓይኔም የሚጠባበቁኝን ተመለከተች፤ \q በእኔ ላይ ስለሚነሡ ክፉ አድራጊዎች ጆሮዎቼ ሰሙ።
am.B: ዓይኖቼ ያደቡብኝን በድል አድራጊነት ተመለከቱ፤ \q ጆሮዎቼም በእኔ ላይ በተነሡ ክፉ አድራጊዎች ላይ የደረሰውን ሰሙ።
am.R: ጠላቶቼ ሲሸነፉ አየሁ። \q ያጠቁኝ ክፉ ሰዎች የደረሰባቸውን ፍጻሜ ሰማሁ።

hi.L: और मेरी आँख ने मेरी घात में रहनेवालों को देखा है; \q जो कुकर्मी मेरे विरुद्ध उठते हैं, उनके विषय में मेरे कानों ने सुना है।
hi.B: मेरी आँखों ने विजय के साथ उन्हें देखा है जो मेरी घात में बैठे थे; \q मेरे कानों ने सुना है कि मेरे विरुद्ध उठनेवाले कुकर्मियों का क्या हुआ।
hi.R: मैंने अपने शत्रुओं को हारते देखा है। \q मैंने उन दुष्ट लोगों के अंत के बारे में सुना है जिन्होंने मुझ पर हमला किया था।

ru.L: И мой глаз смотрел на подстерегающих меня; \q о восстающих на меня злодеях слышали мои уши.
ru.B: Мои глаза с торжеством смотрели на тех, кто подстерегал меня; \q мои уши слышали, что стало со злодеями, восставшими на меня.
ru.R: Я видел, как мои враги потерпели поражение. \q Я слышал о конце злых людей, которые нападали на меня.

ja.L: わたしの目は、わたしを待ち伏せる者たちを眺め、 \q わたしに逆らって立つ者たち、悪をなす者たちのことを、わたしの耳は聞いた。
ja.B: わたしの目は、わたしを待ち伏せしていた者たちを、勝ち誇って見下ろした。 \q わたしに立ち向かってきた悪をなす者たちがどうなったかを、わたしの耳は聞いた。
ja.R: わたしは、敵が打ち負かされるのを見た。 \q わたしを襲った悪い人たちの最期について聞いた。

decisions.choice: my watchers: enemies lying in wait
decisions.reason: The word (shur) is taken as the one in 5:9 and 27:11, those who watch closely for a chance to attack. A word spelled the same way means "wall".

decisions.choice: look on: look on in triumph
decisions.reason: To look on enemies is to see them defeated (54:9; 118:7). The Hebrew does not say what was seen or heard; the sense is their downfall.

decisions.choice: in triumph, what became of (B); defeated, the end of (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what was seen and heard (m2).

decisions.choice: shuray "わたしを待ち伏せる者たち" (L, B), "敵" (R); mere'im "悪をなす者たち" (L, B), "悪い人たち" (R); "勝ち誇って" (B) supplied
decisions.reason: The watchers are enemies lying in wait (m1, uncertain); looking on them is looking on in triumph (m2), supplied at B and R as the English does.

source.text: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] righteous like the palm tree will flourish; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow.

en.L: [The] righteous like the palm tree will flourish; \q like a cedar in Lebanon {{gender:they|he}} will grow.
en.B: The righteous will thrive like the palm tree \q and rise tall as a cedar on Lebanon.
en.R: People who do what is right will grow strong like palm trees. \q They will grow tall like the cedar trees in Lebanon.

fr.L: [Le] juste comme le palmier fleurira ; \q comme un cèdre du Liban il grandira.
fr.B: Le juste prospérera comme le palmier \q et s’élèvera comme un cèdre du Liban.
fr.R: Ceux qui font ce qui est juste deviendront forts comme des palmiers. \q Ils deviendront grands comme les cèdres du Liban.

sw.L: Mwenye haki atastawi kama mtende; \q atakua kama mwerezi katika Lebanoni.
sw.B: Wenye haki watasitawi kama mtende \q na kuinuka warefu kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda haki watakua na nguvu kama mitende. \q Watakua warefu kama mierezi ya Lebanoni.

es.L: [El] justo florecerá como la palmera; \q crecerá como un cedro en el Líbano.
es.B: El justo florecerá como la palmera \q y se alzará como un cedro del Líbano.
es.R: Los que hacen lo que es justo crecerán fuertes como las palmeras. \q Crecerán altos como los cedros del Líbano.

vi.L: Người công chính sẽ tươi tốt như cây chà là; \q người ấy sẽ lớn lên như cây bá hương ở Li-ban.
vi.B: Người công chính sẽ xanh tươi như cây chà là \q và vươn cao như cây bá hương trên núi Li-ban.
vi.R: Những người làm điều ngay thẳng sẽ lớn mạnh như cây chà là. \q Họ sẽ vươn cao như những cây bá hương ở Li-ban.

ko.L: 의인은 종려나무처럼 번성하고, \q 레바논의 백향목처럼 자랄 것이다.
ko.B: 의인은 종려나무처럼 무성하고 \q 레바논의 백향목처럼 높이 자랄 것이다.
ko.R: 바르게 사는 사람들은 종려나무처럼 튼튼하게 자랄 것이다. \q 레바논의 백향목처럼 높이 자랄 것이다.

pt.L: [O] justo florescerá como a palmeira; \q como um cedro no Líbano {{gender:eles crescerão|ele crescerá}}.
pt.B: Os justos vão prosperar como a palmeira \q e crescer altos como um cedro no Líbano.
pt.R: As pessoas que fazem o que é certo vão ficar fortes como as palmeiras. \q Vão crescer altas como os cedros do Líbano.

am.L: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘንባባ ያብባል፤ \q በሊባኖስ እንዳለ ዝግባ ያድጋል።
am.B: ጻድቃን እንደ ዘንባባ ይለመልማሉ፤ \q በሊባኖስም እንዳለ ዝግባ ከፍ ብለው ያድጋሉ።
am.R: ትክክል የሆነውን የሚያደርጉ ሰዎች እንደ ዘንባባ ዛፍ ይበረታሉ። \q በሊባኖስ እንዳሉ የዝግባ ዛፎች ረጅም ሆነው ያድጋሉ።

hi.L: धर्मी खजूर के पेड़ के समान फूले-फलेगा; \q लबानोन के देवदार के समान {{gender:वे बढ़ते जाएँगे|वह बढ़ता जाएगा}}।
hi.B: धर्मी खजूर के पेड़ की तरह फलेंगे-फूलेंगे \q और लबानोन के देवदार की तरह ऊँचे उठेंगे।
hi.R: जो लोग सही काम करते हैं, वे खजूर के पेड़ों की तरह मज़बूत होंगे। \q वे लबानोन के देवदार के पेड़ों की तरह ऊँचे बढ़ेंगे।

ru.L: Праведный, как пальма, будет цвести; \q как кедр на Ливане, будет расти.
ru.B: Праведные будут процветать, как пальма, \q и подниматься высоко, как кедр на Ливане.
ru.R: Люди, которые поступают правильно, станут крепкими, как пальмы. \q Они вырастут высокими, как кедры на Ливане.

ja.L: 正しい者は、なつめやしのように花を咲かせ、 \q レバノンの杉のように育つ。
ja.B: 正しい人は、なつめやしの木のように栄え、 \q レバノンの杉のように高く伸びる。
ja.R: 正しいことをする人たちは、なつめやしの木のように、元気に育つ。 \q レバノンの杉の木のように、高く伸びる。

decisions.choice: palm and cedar: green, tall and long-lived
decisions.reason: The date palm stays green in dry land and bears fruit for many years; the cedars of Lebanon were the tallest and strongest trees known (Isaiah 2:13; Ezekiel 31:3). They stand against the grass of verse 8.

decisions.choice: the righteous: those who live rightly before God
decisions.reason: The word (tsaddiq) is singular, standing for every such person (1:6).

decisions.choice: they (with "he" as the alternative at Literal)
decisions.reason: "The righteous" stands for anyone who lives this way (m2), so Literal gives "they" by default; Balanced and Readable need no pronoun or use the plural.

decisions.choice: "il" for the righteous at Literal, with no gender setting
alternatives: a span on the pronoun, as the English "they|he"
decisions.reason: French puts the gender setting on nouns only; "le juste ... il" is ordinary generic French and means anyone who is righteous.

decisions.choice: el justo ... crecerá, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "they" with "he" as the alternative. In Spanish "el justo" and its verb already take in any person who lives rightly, so Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew singular with no setting.

decisions.choice: "người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "người công chính" and "người ấy" already include men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the English gender setting to switch to.

decisions.choice: Verses 13-16 speak about the righteous and about the LORD in the plain written style
decisions.reason: The prayer to God ends with verse 12; the closing lines speak of the righteous and of God in the third person, and Korean uses the voice the style guide (section 7a) gives to speech about God. Korean "의인" and "그들" need no gender span.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:वे बढ़ते जाएँगे|वह बढ़ता जाएगा}}"
decisions.reason: "The righteous" stands for anyone who lives this way (meaning m2), so Literal gives the plural by default and the Hebrew singular as the alternative, as the English does; the span holds the verb, which agrees with the pronoun in Hindi. The first line keeps the singular "फूले-फलेगा" with "धर्मी", as the Hebrew does. Lebanon is "लबानोन", as in Kings.

decisions.choice: no pronoun and no gender setting
decisions.reason: Russian needs no pronoun in the second line ("будет расти" agrees with "праведный"), so the English setting ("they" or "he") has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: tsaddiq "正しい者" (L), "正しい人" (B), "正しいことをする人たち" (R), with no pronoun and no gender span; tamar "なつめやし"; Levanon "レバノン"
decisions.reason: The English gender span on the pronoun (they / he) is not needed: Japanese leaves the pronoun out. Palm and cedar are green, tall and long-lived (m1).

source.text: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Planted in [the] house of YHWH, in [the] courts of our God they will flourish.

en.L: Planted in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q in the courts of our God they will flourish.
en.B: Rooted in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house, \q they will bloom in the courtyards of our God.
en.R: They are like trees planted at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They grow strong in the courtyards of our God's temple.

fr.L: Plantés dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q dans les parvis de notre Dieu ils fleuriront.
fr.B: Enracinés dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q ils fleuriront dans les parvis de notre Dieu.
fr.R: Ils sont comme des arbres plantés près de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Ils deviennent forts dans les cours du temple de notre Dieu.

sw.L: Wamepandwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q katika nyua za Mungu wetu watastawi.
sw.B: Wakiwa na mizizi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q watachanua katika nyua za Mungu wetu.
sw.R: Wao ni kama miti iliyopandwa nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Wanakua na nguvu katika viwanja vya hekalu la Mungu wetu.

es.L: Plantados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q en los atrios de nuestro Dios florecerán.
es.B: Arraigados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q florecerán en los atrios de nuestro Dios.
es.R: Son como árboles plantados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Crecen fuertes en los patios del templo de nuestro Dios.

vi.L: Được trồng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q họ sẽ tươi tốt trong các sân của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Được bén rễ trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q họ sẽ nở hoa trong các sân của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.R: Họ như những cây được trồng tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Họ lớn mạnh trong sân đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 심긴 이들은 \q 우리 하나님의 뜰에서 번성할 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 뿌리내린 이들은 \q 우리 하나님의 뜰에서 꽃을 피울 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 심긴 나무와 같다. \q 그들은 우리 하나님의 성전 뜰에서 튼튼하게 자란다.

pt.L: Plantados na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q nos átrios do nosso Deus florescerão.
pt.B: Enraizados na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q eles vão florescer nos pátios do nosso Deus.
pt.R: Eles são como árvores plantadas na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. \q Eles crescem fortes nos pátios do templo do nosso Deus.

am.B: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ሥር የሰደዱ \q በአምላካችን አደባባዮች ያብባሉ።
am.R: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ እንደ ተተከሉ ዛፎች ናቸው። \q በአምላካችን ቤተ መቅደስ አደባባዮች ይበረታሉ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में लगाए हुए, \q वे हमारे परमेश्वर के आँगनों में फूले-फलेंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में जड़ पकड़े हुए, \q वे हमारे परमेश्वर के आँगनों में खिलेंगे।
hi.R: वे उन पेड़ों के समान हैं जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में लगाए गए हैं। \q वे हमारे परमेश्वर के मंदिर के आँगनों में मज़बूत होते जाते हैं।

ru.L: Посаженные в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q во дворах нашего Бога они будут цвести.
ru.B: Укоренённые в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q они расцветут во дворах нашего Бога.
ru.R: Они как деревья, посаженные у дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. \q Они крепнут во дворах храма нашего Бога.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に植えられ、 \q わたしたちの神の庭で、彼らは花を咲かせる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に根を下ろし、 \q わたしたちの神の庭で花開く。
ja.R: 彼らは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に植えられた木のようだ。 \q わたしたちの神の神殿の庭で、元気に育つ。

decisions.choice: planted in the house of the LORD: living near God
decisions.reason: Trees in the temple courts are a picture of those who live close to God and draw life from him (52:10; 1:3).

decisions.choice: They are like trees
decisions.reason: Readable makes the comparison clear.

decisions.choice: beveit YHWH "DNの家"; chatsrot "庭" (L, B), "神殿の庭" (R)
decisions.reason: Planted in the LORD's house is living near God (m1); the courts are the temple courts, as in 65:5.

source.text: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Still they will bear fruit in old age; full of sap and fresh they will be,

en.L: Still they will bear fruit in old age; \q full of sap and fresh they will be,
en.B: Even when they are old they will still bear fruit; \q they will stay rich with sap and green,
en.R: Even when they are old, they will still produce fruit. \q They will stay healthy and strong.

fr.L: Encore ils porteront du fruit dans la vieillesse ; \q pleins de sève et verts ils seront,
fr.B: Même vieux, ils porteront encore du fruit ; \q ils resteront pleins de sève et verdoyants,
fr.R: Même quand ils seront vieux, ils donneront encore des fruits. \q Ils resteront en bonne santé et forts.

sw.L: Bado watazaa matunda katika uzee; \q watakuwa wamejaa utomvu na wabichi,
sw.B: Hata wakiwa wazee bado watazaa matunda; \q watabaki wamejaa utomvu na wabichi,
sw.R: Hata wakiwa wazee, bado watazaa matunda. \q Watabaki wazima na wenye nguvu.

es.L: Aún darán fruto en la vejez; \q llenos de savia y frondosos estarán,
es.B: Aun cuando sean viejos seguirán dando fruto; \q se mantendrán llenos de savia y verdes,
es.R: Aun cuando sean viejos, seguirán dando fruto. \q Se mantendrán sanos y fuertes.

vi.L: Dù về già họ vẫn sẽ sinh trái; \q họ sẽ đầy nhựa sống và tươi tốt,
vi.B: Ngay cả khi tuổi đã cao, họ vẫn sinh hoa kết trái; \q họ sẽ luôn đầy nhựa sống và xanh tươi,
vi.R: Ngay cả khi đã già, họ vẫn sinh trái. \q Họ sẽ luôn khỏe mạnh và vững vàng.

ko.L: 그들은 늙어서도 여전히 열매를 맺고, \q 수액이 가득하고 싱싱할 것이니,
ko.B: 그들은 늙어서도 여전히 열매를 맺고, \q 물기가 가득하여 늘 푸를 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 나이가 들어도 여전히 열매를 맺을 것이다. \q 그들은 늘 건강하고 힘이 있을 것이다.

pt.L: Ainda darão fruto na velhice; \q cheios de seiva e viçosos serão,
pt.B: Mesmo na velhice ainda darão frutos; \q continuarão cheios de seiva e verdes,
pt.R: Mesmo quando estiverem velhos, eles ainda vão dar frutos. \q Vão continuar com saúde e força.

am.L: በሽምግልናም ገና ያፈራሉ፤ \q ልምላሜና ትኩስነት ይሞላቸዋል፣
am.B: በሸመገሉ ጊዜም እንኳ ገና ፍሬ ያፈራሉ፤ \q ልምላሜ የሞላባቸውና ለምለሞች ይሆናሉ፣
am.R: በሸመገሉ ጊዜ እንኳ ገና ፍሬ ያፈራሉ። \q ጤነኞችና ብርቱዎች ሆነው ይኖራሉ።

hi.L: वे बुढ़ापे में भी फल लाएँगे; \q वे रस से भरे और हरे-भरे रहेंगे,
hi.B: बूढ़े होकर भी वे फल लाते रहेंगे; \q वे रस से भरपूर और हरे बने रहेंगे,
hi.R: बूढ़े होने पर भी वे फल लाते रहेंगे। \q वे स्वस्थ और बलवान बने रहेंगे।

ru.L: Ещё и в старости они будут приносить плод; \q полны соков и свежи они будут,
ru.B: Даже в старости они будут приносить плоды; \q они останутся сочными и зелёными,
ru.R: Даже в старости они будут приносить плоды. \q Они останутся здоровыми и крепкими.

ja.L: 年老いても、彼らはなお実を結び、 \q 樹液に満ちて、青々としている。
ja.B: 年老いても、なお実を結び、 \q いつまでも樹液に富み、青々としている。
ja.R: 年をとっても、彼らはなお実を結ぶ。 \q いつまでも健康で、力にあふれている。

decisions.choice: full of sap and fresh: healthy and vigorous
decisions.reason: The first word (dashen) means fat, rich, and so thriving; the second (ra'anan) is green and fresh, the word used of the oil in verse 11.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The thought continues in verse 16, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: healthy and strong
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: The verse closes with 。 and 92:16 restarts with [それは] / それは / 彼らの生き方が
decisions.reason: The English sentence runs on into 92:16 (m2); Japanese closes each verse and picks up the purpose clause in the next, as in the Psalter's other run-on verses.

source.text: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־עַוְלָ֥תָה בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: to declare that upright [is] YHWH, my rock, and there is no injustice in him.

en.L: to declare that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] upright — \q my rock, and there is no injustice in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: bearing witness that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is just: \q my rock, in whom nothing is crooked.
en.R: Their lives will show that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is fair. \q He is my rock, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never does anything wrong.

fr.L: pour annoncer que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] droit — \q mon rocher, et il n’y a pas d’injustice en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: témoignant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste : \q mon rocher, en qui rien n’est tordu.
fr.R: Leur vie montrera que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste. \q Il est mon rocher, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne fait jamais rien de mal.

sw.L: ili kutangaza kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mnyofu, \q mwamba wangu, wala hakuna uovu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: wakishuhudia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki: \q mwamba wangu, ambaye hakuna upotovu wowote ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Maisha yao yataonyesha kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki. \q Yeye ni mwamba wangu, wala hafanyi kamwe jambo lolote baya.

es.L: para anunciar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] recto: \q mi roca, y no hay injusticia en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: dando testimonio de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es justo: \q mi roca, en quien no hay nada torcido.
es.R: Su vida mostrará que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es justo. \q Él es mi roca, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nunca hace nada malo.

vi.L: để rao truyền rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] ngay thẳng, \q vầng đá của tôi, và không có sự bất công nào trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: để làm chứng rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng công chính: \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là vầng đá của tôi, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng có gì gian tà.
vi.R: Đời sống của họ sẽ cho thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng công bằng. \q Ngài là vầng đá của tôi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ làm điều gì sai trái.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바르시다는 것을 알리려는 것이다. \q 그분은 나의 반석이시니, 그분께는 불의가 없다.
ko.B: 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 의로우시다는 것을 증언하는 것이다. \q 그분은 나의 반석이시니, 그분께는 굽은 것이 전혀 없다.
ko.R: 그들의 삶이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 공정하시다는 것을 보여 줄 것이다. \q 그분은 나의 반석이시고, 결코 잘못된 일을 하지 않으신다.

pt.L: para anunciar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] reto — \q a minha rocha, e não há injustiça {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.B: dando testemunho de que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é justo: \q a minha rocha, em quem não há nada de torto.
pt.R: A vida deles vai mostrar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é justo. \q Ele é a minha rocha, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não faz nada de errado.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቅን እንደ ሆነ ሊናገሩ፤ \q እርሱ ዓለቴ ነው፤ በእርሱም ግፍ የለም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክለኛ መሆኑን ይመሰክራሉ፤ \q እርሱ ዓለቴ ነው፤ በእርሱም ጠማማ ነገር የለም።
am.R: ሕይወታቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ፍትሐዊ መሆኑን ያሳያል። \q እርሱ ዓለቴ ነው፤ ምንም ክፉ ነገር ከቶ አያደርግም።

hi.L: यह बताने के लिए कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सीधे [हैं] — \q मेरी चट्टान, और उनमें कोई कुटिलता नहीं।
hi.B: और यह गवाही देंगे कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} न्यायी हैं: \q मेरी चट्टान, जिनमें कुछ भी टेढ़ा नहीं।
hi.R: उनका जीवन दिखाएगा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} न्यायी हैं। \q वे मेरी चट्टान हैं, और वे कभी कुछ ग़लत नहीं करते।

ru.L: чтобы возвещать, что прям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — \q моя скала, и нет в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} несправедливости.
ru.B: свидетельствуя, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} справедлив: \q моя скала, в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} нет ничего кривого.
ru.R: Их жизнь покажет, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} справедлив. \q Он — моя скала, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} никогда не поступает неправильно.

ja.L: [それは]{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がまっすぐであることを告げるためである。 \q わたしの岩、その方には不正がない。
ja.B: それは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が正しい方であることを証しするためである。 \q その方はわたしの岩、その方には少しの曲がったところもない。
ja.R: 彼らの生き方が、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は公平な方だということを示す。 \q その方はわたしの岩。その方は決して悪いことをなさらない。

decisions.choice: upright, rock, no injustice: the song of Moses
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 32:4 uses the same words of God: "the Rock ... a God of faithfulness and without injustice, righteous and upright is he".

decisions.choice: my rock: a safe, unshakable place
decisions.reason: As in 18:3, a rock is a place of safety and strength.

decisions.choice: Their lives will show
decisions.reason: Readable says how the flourishing righteous declare it: by what their lives show.

decisions.choice: Verse 16 begins a sentence of its own ("... 알리려는 것이다", "그것은 ... 증언하는 것이다"), and verse 15 ends with a stop at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew infinitive "to declare" continues verse 15. Korean puts a purpose clause before the verb it depends on, which would move verse 16 into verse 15, so Korean restates it as its own sentence.

decisions.choice: reto, sem injustiça (L); não faz nada de errado (R)
decisions.reason: The verse echoes the song of Moses (m1), so it takes the words of Deuteronomy 32:4's Portuguese at the same levels: "reto" and "injustiça" at Literal, "não faz nada de errado" at Readable. "Rocha" stays lower case, as the English "my rock".

decisions.choice: "ዓለት", "ቅን" and "ግፍ" (rock, upright, injustice), the words of Deuteronomy 32:4 in the Amharic on main
decisions.reason: The meaning decision hears the Song of Moses in this line; the shared words keep Deuteronomy 32:4's Amharic.

decisions.choice: "मेरी चट्टान"
decisions.reason: The rock (tsur, meaning m2) is "मेरी चट्टान", as the poetry note and 2 Samuel 22 have it; God then takes the honorific third person ("उनमें", "जिनमें", "वे").

decisions.choice: "моя скала"
decisions.reason: Tsur is "скала", as the poetry note and 2 Samuel 22 settle.

decisions.choice: yashar "まっすぐ" (L), "正しい方" (B), "公平な方" (R); tsuri "わたしの岩"; 'avlatah "不正" (L), "曲がったところ" (B), "悪いことをなさらない" (R)
decisions.reason: Upright, rock and no injustice echo the song of Moses (m1); the rock is a safe, unshakable place (m2). God's negative is なさらない, never 〜られない.
